positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: What distinguishes owned intelligence and perspective — the asset kept — from rented intelligence and the commoditized substrate it runs on?
positions.why: Both expressions render the same antithesis in the same plain-spoken, aphoristic register (register mint-1: AphoristicTechnicalMaxim) and the same value orientation (value mint-1: OwnedIntelligenceAsAsset — autonomy/self-enhancement via possession rather than lease). Relational and power reads agree: both frame the distinction through market-pricing proportionality (owned vs. rented, commodity vs. asset) argued via rational-persuasion rather than authority. Conviction differs in strength — src-2 lands as a flat categorical claim, src-3 as a constitutive, creed-like principle — but both perform the same directional stance (owned intelligence/perspective is the thing retained; substrate/rented intelligence is not), so the gradient sits inside one coherent group rather than splitting it.
